marketing.badgeText: Courses from A1 to C2 are open for applications
marketing.heroText: Sprachweg turns your PDFs, slides, recordings and quizzes into a structured course, releases each unit exactly when you want, and lets you hand-pick your learners.
marketing.levelsIntro: Every step of the Common European Framework of Reference
marketing.featuresTitle: Everything a German course needs. Nothing it doesn't.
marketing.featuresText: Designed with DaF/DaZ teachers who run small groups and want full control over what learners see and when.

build.title: Build any course
build.body: No fixed template. Modules hold lessons of any type, reordered with drag & drop, even across modules.

files.title: Any file type
files.body: PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, MP3, MP4, images or ZIP. Upload with progress, preview inline, download offline.

schedule.title: Schedule publishing
schedule.body: Publish now, at a date, or for a window. Course, module and lesson each have their own Draft · Scheduled · Live state.

waitlist.title: Waitlist approval
waitlist.body: Learners apply with a message; you approve, reject or remove them individually or in bulk, or add them directly by e-mail, always respecting capacity.

quizzes.title: Quizzes & exams
quizzes.body: Six question types, audio and image prompts for listening and reading comprehension, timers, attempts and manual essay grading.

progress.title: Progress tracking
progress.body: Learners see what's next and how far they've come; you see each learner's progress per course.

marketing.instructorsTitle: From folder of files to finished course
marketing.learnersTitle: A clear path from Hallo to fluent

build.title: Build
build.body: Create a course, add modules and drop in your existing material.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.body: Release one unit per week automatically, or publish everything now.

approve.title: Approve
approve.body: Review applications on your waitlist and admit learners in one click.

discover.body: Browse by level, read the outline and meet the instructor.

apply.body: Send a short message; you'll be notified as soon as you're accepted.

learn.title: Learn
learn.body: Work through lessons, listen, read, test yourself and track progress.

useCases.title: Made for the way German is taught
useCases.text: Three typical ways teachers and learners use Sprachweg.

weekly.title: One new unit every week
weekly.text: Upload a whole term of PDFs, slides, audio and quizzes once. Schedule each unit and it unlocks on its own, exactly when you planned.

groups.title: Small, hand-picked groups
groups.text: Limit seats, read every application with its message and admit learners individually or in bulk. Nobody sees content before you say yes.

exam.title: Mock exams with real feedback
exam.text: Timed exams with listening tasks, auto-graded questions and essays your instructor grades with personal feedback.

review.pendingText: Thanks for joining Sprachweg as a teacher! Our team checks every instructor account before courses can be created. This usually takes one to two working days.
review.step1: We review your account details. Adding a short bio to your profile helps.
review.step2: You'll receive an e-mail as soon as your account is approved.
review.step3: Then you can build, schedule and publish your first course.
review.rejectedTitle: Your instructor application was not approved
review.rejectedText: Unfortunately we couldn't approve your instructor account, so you can't create courses. You can still use Sprachweg as a learner. If you think this is a mistake, please contact us.

goodbye.note: You're always welcome back: you can create a new account at any time.
